  for p in $(pidof getty 2>/dev/null || true); do
    if [ "$p" != "$old_pid" ] && [ "$(readlink "/proc/$p/fd/0" 2>/dev/null || true)" = /dev/tty1 ]; then new_pid=$p; break; fi
  done
  [ -n "$new_pid" ] && break
